title: Reported Address of the Thief
prompt: At what address did the caller report the thief?
hint: Include '42 Maple Street' and that the thief was inside the house.
sample: At 42 Maple Street, inside the house.

ja.hint: 「メープル通り42番地」で家の中にいると含めてください。
ja.sample: メープル通り42番地の家の中です。
